value.rationale: The stationary total-number variance of finite reservoir-coupled exclusion is a natural non-equilibrium observable; its exact graph-spectral expression and sharp finite edge-strengthening response make connectivity effects testable and quantify equality. The explicit three-harmonic solution gives every two-site covariance on K_n with arbitrary spatial reservoir heterogeneity, and the global mean/variance recover the squared bath heterogeneity from aggregate observations. This is not merely a renamed sign result or an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
